hypothesis: A causal 90-day marked-NAV comparison between the universal 2/3-at-2R-plus-runner shadow and the universal full-runner shadow can choose an exit mix while retaining the corrected V1.7 event universe, entry priority, slot capacity, fees, and native VectorBT fill paths.
single_variable: For each entry, use the full-runner exits for both child legs only when its own cohort's preceding 90-day full-runner NAV return exceeds the corresponding 2/3 shadow return; otherwise keep the native 2R target on two-thirds and the native runner on one-third.

account.entry_priority: frozen source priority (low prior ATR first), then original entry-time/contract tie-break
account.selected_full_runner_execution: Reuse each event's native tp_r=0 runner path as both tp_r=0 and tp_r=2 child legs, then let the shared VectorBT scaleout account execute and value both legs.

selector.measure: Each static shadow's NAV at exact completed H1 close labels: nav_end/nav_start-1, where end is event entry_ms minus 12 hours and start is end minus 90 days.
selector.boundary_evidence: Both NAV timestamps must exist; for each symbol still open at a boundary in either shadow, the exact native H1 bar ending at that boundary must be present. The engine marks that bar from its native close; no carried mark or interpolation validates a decision boundary.
selector.arm_rule: Select full_runner only when its own-cohort trailing return exceeds partial_2_3 by more than 1e-12.
selector.decision_scope: Make one decision per event at its own 12H-confirmed entry open. Actual and eligible paired controls each use their own static shadow histories.

runner_reuse_review.OKX: Existing leadership fraction=1.0 output is 100% at the 2R target; it is not a full runner curve. The equity-stop account changes the exit rule.
runner_reuse_review.Binance: Existing Binance transfer runner candidate uses an earlier data cutoff and the pre-repair event set. It is not the corrected full-period runner.
runner_reuse_review.decision: Reprice the full-runner shadow through the existing VectorBT wallet from the corrected per-event native paths.

evaluation.stress: Additional 0.0005 market slippage on taker fills; maker 2R limits retain their native fee and zero market slippage.
evaluation.static_parity_gate: Before freezing choices, static 2/3 actual account must match the corrected reference's funded event IDs, per-trade cash PnL/entry/exit fields, every hourly NAV and conservative mark, and all-period metrics.
evaluation.same_slot_gate: Static partial and full-runner shadows must fund identical event IDs in identical slots; rotated account admissions and slots must match its static shadow roster.

limitations: Hourly OHLC cannot reveal the exact intrabar ordering of open-position mark excursions; drawdown uses the existing conservative bounds.
The 12-hour selector lag is intentionally conservative; entries without exact lookback NAV or native boundary quote evidence default to 2/3.
This is a historical research comparison, not a production or deployment authorization.
